props.text:
# Master Services Agreement CON-2025-077: Kite Grocers

## 4. Service levels
Northwind Pay guarantees 99.9% monthly uptime for Hosted Checkout.

## 5. Service credits
If monthly uptime falls below the target, the customer receives a service credit of 5% of that month's fees.
